how.title: How this project works
how.step1: The PM writes a BRD, and an agent drafts the PRD.
how.step2: The owner, a PM, or a tech lead approves the PRD.
how.step3: An agent breaks the PRD into epics and stories.
how.step4: The PM refines the stories and publishes the epic.
how.step5: Tasks appear on the board for the people assigned.
